Need help?

Start on the Check tab. Enter your marks and read the label and the words on each result. "Appears to meet" means you seem to meet the minimums we can check. It does not mean you have been accepted.

The Funding tab lists bursaries with their closing dates. A closing date that has passed means the call for that year is over. Check the provider's page for the next one.

Stuck? Ask your school career guidance teacher or the institution's admissions office. Their contact details are on their website.

Always confirm on the institution's official website. Meeting a minimum does not guarantee admission, and each institution scores applicants differently, so scores cannot be compared across institutions.
